title: What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.20000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different modalities converge toward a shared representation. Related work aligns frozen image and text encoders on natural images without paired data. We test zero-pair alignment on five datasets across four modalities: natural images, environmental audio, chest radiographs, and 3D computed tomography (CT). It succeeds only on COCO and fails on the other four. We analyze the failures and find that alignment must first locate the subspace where the modalities co-vary and then orient the mapping within it. Consistent with previous studies, medical imaging is the hardest case: its shared subspace carries the smallest fraction of the variance. When this fraction is small, alignment needs image-text pairs, and random-matrix theory predicts how many pairs are needed. translated_title: 什么决定了跨模态对齐的成败
translated_abstract: 柏拉图表示假说认为，在不同模态数据上训练的模型会收敛到一种共享的表示。已有相关工作在没有配对数据的情况下对自然图像上的冻结图像编码器和文本编码器进行对齐。我们在涵盖四种模态（自然图像、环境音频、胸部X光片和3D计算机断层扫描CT）的五个数据集上测试了零配对对齐。该方法仅在COCO数据集上成功，而在其他四个数据集上均告失败。我们对这些失败进行了分析，发现对齐必须首先定位模态之间发生共变的子空间，然后在该子空间内确定映射方向。与此前的研究一致，医学成像是其中最困难的情况：其共享子空间所承载的方差比例最小。当这一比例较小时，对齐需要图像-文本配对数据，而随机矩阵理论可以预测需要多少配对数据。这些发现启发了LightAlign方法：仅需少量配对数据，通过两个冻结编码器之间的岭回归即可定位（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了跨模态对齐成败的关键在于模态共变子空间所承载的方差比例，并据此提出LightAlign方法，仅需少量图像-文本配对数据通过岭回归即可完成两个冻结编码器之间的对齐。
en_tdlr: This work shows that cross-modal alignment success hinges on the fraction of variance carried by the co-variation subspace of modalities, and proposes LightAlign, which aligns two frozen encoders using only a few image-text pairs via ridge regression.
